niche_preference_profile: This user tends to prefer polished, high-clarity interfaces with strong hierarchy, complete and functional-looking content, and controlled visual systems. They repeatedly favor layouts that feel intentional and production-ready, with clear grouping, obvious actions, and reduced ambiguity. Their taste is mixed on light vs dark and on density vs spaciousness depending on context, but they consistently respond well to coherent structure, restrained accents, balanced emphasis, and interfaces that feel focused rather than noisy or unfinished.

criteria.description: clear, strongly structured hierarchy with obvious titles, section labels, grouped content, and easy scan order
screens that feel fully populated, complete, usable, and production-ready rather than sparse, empty, or concept-like
content organized into clearly separated sections or modules with coherent internal grouping
controls that make state, progression, or logic explicit, such as segmented selectors, visible dependencies, and clear next/back actions
fewer competing elements, less decorative interruption, and cleaner focus on the main task
one dominant focal area or task, with surrounding context subdued so attention is not split across multiple competing regions
muted, disciplined accent colors used selectively rather than loud, repetitive, or overly saturated emphasis
a composed, premium, serious, and polished visual mood rather than casual, generic, promotional, or panic-inducing presentation
primary and secondary actions that are clearly prioritized but not overly forceful, with balanced emphasis across controls
shorter, tighter, more direct text that improves scanability and reduces explanatory heaviness
